description: Get detailed snow and weather measurements for a specific SLF station. IMIS stations return 30-min data (snow depth, temperature, humidity, wind, radiation). Study plots return daily data (snow depth, new snow, water equivalent). Use list_snow_stations to find station codes.

station_code.description: Station code (e.g. DAV2, WFJ2, 4AO0). Use list_snow_stations to find codes.

type.description: Station type: "imis" (default) or "study-plot". Determines which API endpoint to query.

name: get_snow_measurements
